It contains every required clause. It says the agent no longer saves notes unless memory.save_text_memories is on, and marks this as a behavior change for existing deployments. It tells TOML/env operators to set save_text_memories = true (or SQLLENS_MEMORY__SAVE_TEXT_MEMORIES=true), and tells MCPB users to turn on the new checkbox. Earlier notes stay in memory and are still used. Agent-saved notes cannot be told apart from imported ones. TOML/env operators can review and delete wrong notes with the memory-administration tools, with a link to managing-memory.md#memory-administration-tools-for-the-assistant. That link matches the heading at managing-memory.md:128. It also says MCPB settings offer no way to turn those tools on. No trigger-condition code is involved; this is a docs claim.
